description.value: Fairmont Mountainside Market is a local supermarket serving the Fairmont Hot Springs community in the Kootenay Rockies of British Columbia. Situated in a small resort community at roughly 50.34°N along the Columbia Valley, it likely serves as the primary grocery stop for residents and visitors in the area. For touring cyclists passing through on the Columbia Valley route, it represents a key resupply point between larger centres.
